Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Muneeba Ali and Bismah Maroof are the openers for Pakistan Women. Megan Schutt has the new ball in her hand.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Pakistan Women started well getting rid of Alyssa Healy and Meg Lanning early and were on top after the powerplay. But couldn't capitalize on that start and gave away too many boundary balls, they were pretty sloppy in the field too, and never looked like breaking the stand between Mooney and McGrath. They will be disappointed with their effort with the ball and now they are looking at a mountain chase to win this game. If they are to chase this total down it will take mammoth effort. Looking at the Australian bowling it does not look good for Pakistan Women. They have also not had the best of times with the blade. But can they do something special here? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay!

This has been a brilliant effort from Tahlia McGrath and Beth Mooney to take Australia Women to a total that looks out of reach for Pakistan Women. Tahlia McGrath came into the crease when Australia Women were in slight trouble losing two quick wickets. But that didn't have an effect on her as she played her shots and found the boundaries with ease and got to her half-ton pretty quickly. She was well supported by Beth Mooney who took her time at the start but once she got the hold of this wicket she freed her arms as well. She also brought up her half-century and both of them together added over 100 runs for the third wicket. and guided Australia Women to a score of 160. They will be pretty happy with this effort and will be confident to defend it.

FOUR! A lovely finish for Australia Women! Aiman Anwer serves a full toss and gives width outside off. Tahlia McGrath gets this to the deep cover fence in no time for a boundary! Tahlia McGrath has played a superb innings here and along with Beth Mooney, gotten Australia Women to a solid total of 160!
Goes full and way outside off, Tahlia McGrath looks to clip this leg side and does not connect well. Gets an inside edge onto her pads and it is a valuable dot.
This is full and wide outside off, Beth Mooney goes for the reverse sweep and gets a bottom edge towards short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! This is a good-looking shot! Aiman Anwer is short this time and outside off, Beth Mooney pulls this towards the deep square leg boundary for another boundary! This is now an exhibition!
This is full from 'round the wicket, Beth Mooney looks to sweep and gets a top edge towards the vacant square leg region for a couple of runs.
Aiman Anwer goes full and wide outside off, Tahlia McGrath moves around in the crease and goes wide outside off to thump this towards deep square leg for a single.

Slightly shorter, around middle. Tahlia McGrath looks to work it away towards square leg but she gets a leading edge towards cover-point. Only a single. A huge over for Australia Women! 21 runs off it!
SIX! A massive hit from Tahlia McGrath! A length ball, around off. Tahlia McGrath swivels and pulls it high over fine leg for the second maximum of the over! 20 runs off the over with one ball to go.
Overpitched delivery, around middle and off. Beth Mooney flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, outside off. Beth Mooney makes room and looks to go over cover but ends up slicing it away from backward point. Two taken!
Wide! Too short this time, outside off. Beth Mooney wanted to scoop this one but she leaves it alone. Wide called!

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Another pitched-up delivery, around off. Beth Mooney sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there, tris to grab the ball, but she fails to do so, and the ball rolls hebidn here for a boundary!
SIX! Up, up and away! Lovely shot! A fuller one, around off. Beth Mooney walks towards the off pole, gets low, and swipes this one aerially towards deep square leg for a biggie!

FOUR! Tahlia McGrath is now in attack mode! This is full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath steps across and flicks the ball towards deep square leg for four more runs! 15 runs have been conceded in the over and a good one for Australia Women!
This has been spanked! Aiman Anwer goes full outside off, Tahlia McGrath hits this beautifully towards deep cover but some good fielding once again restricts them to a brace.
This is full and on the pads, Tahlia McGrath clips this towards deep square leg and some good running as they take two runs.

That is fifty for Beth Mooney now! Also brings up the 100-run partnership between these two! Full delivery angled into the pads and worked to long on for a single. Beth Mooney has been steady and gets a good inning under her belt!
Aiman Anwer goes full outside off, Beth Mooney swings towards the offside and slices it over backward point. Just clears the fielder as they get a brace.

FOUR! Aiman Anwer starts from 'round the wicket and serves this full and outside off, Beth Mooney lofts this straight towards long on. Diana Baig does well to cover the ground and stop the ball. However, it rolls to the ropes, which is four more to Beth Mooney!
Swing and a miss! On a length now, outside off. Tahlia McGrath walks across and tries to pull this but fails to get any connection.
Much slower this time, full, around off. Tahlia McGrath miscues her drive towards the fielder at cover.
Pitches it up again, around middle and off. Beth Mooney flicks it wide of long on. Only a single!

FOUR! In the gap! A better effort was needed in the deep though! A fuller one, outside off from 'round the wicket. Beth Mooney gets low and smashes it in the gap between long on and deep mid-wicket for the second boundary of the over!
Full again, outside off, much slower this time. Tahlia McGrath stays in her crease and taps it towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Well played! A fuller one from Fatima Sana outside off. Tahlia McGrath moves to her off side and swipes this one through square leg for a boundary.
Sadia Iqbal bowls a full toss outside off, Tahlia McGrath goes forward and thumps the ball to deep cover for a single.
Goes full once again and outside off, Beth Mooney shuffles down the wicket and plays the ball to long on for a run.
This is full and just outside off, Tahlia McGrath sweeps this towards backward square leg and a half stop concedes a single.

FOUR! That is fifty for Tahlia McGrath! Sadia Iqbal flights this full on middle, Tahlia McGrath steps to the leg side to make some room and powers it towards long off. There is a fielder there but the ball is straight and hit with some power as it runs to the fence to bring up another half-century for Tahlia McGrath! She has been in great form off late!
Full once again outside off, Beth Mooney gets a stride forward and works the ball to long on for a single.
Sadia Iqbal serves this short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath goes to the off side and pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly shorter, around middle. Tahlia McGrath flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Good over for Australia Women 10 runs off it!
FOUR! Easy pickings! A full toss, around middle and leg. Tahlia McGrath pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary. Australia Women regaining control of the game!
Outside off, full, loopy one as well. Tahlia McGrath goes for the reverse-sweep this time but fails to get any connection on that!
FOUR! Great use of her feet! Much-needed boundary as well! Loopy ball, full from over the wicket, around off. Tahlia McGrath dances down the pitch and goes inside-out over cover for a boundary.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Beth Mooney advances down the track and drives it through cover for a single.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, fuller ball, slower as well. Beth Mooney gets down on her knee and misses her sweep.
A full toss on off to end the over as this is eased to mid off for a run.
Fullish one and around off, Tahlia McGrath opens the face of her bat and drives it through covers for another run.
Darts this one full down the leg side. It is called a wide.
Goes 'round the wicket and serves this full and on middle, Beth Mooney drills it to long on for a single.
She bowl this on a good length and around off, Tahlia McGrath punches it through covers for one.
Full and on off, Tahlia McGrath drives it firmly to mid off.

DROPPED! This is short and around off, Tahlia McGrath looks to punch it through covers but gets a thin outside edge towards the keeper. The keeper cannot grab it and ball rolls towards short third man. The batter runs one but there is an overthrow and they get another run.
Another full toss and on off, Tahlia McGrath moves across and forces it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A high full toss on leg, Beth Mooney skips down the track and flicks it towards square leg, the fielder there dives to her left and makes a terrific stop to keep it down to a single.
Sadia Iqbal continues bowling the full length and attacking the stumps, Tahlia McGrath charges down the wicket and makes room to drill this to deep cover for a single.
Sadia Iqbal serves this full once again, and outside off, Beth Mooney swings and gets an inside edge onto herpads. Takes a single as it rolls towards covers.

That was given out and has been overturned by a review! Sadia Iqbal goes full and in line with the stumps, Tahlia McGrath goes for the reverse sweep and misses as the ball hits her on her back leg. The umpire raises her finger and after some consutation the batter decides to review. UltraEdge shows a slight murmur as the ball passes the gloves. The onfield decision has been reversed! Tahlia McGrath survives...
Sadia Iqbal serves this full and wide outside off, Tahlia McGrath drags the ball towards deep mid-wicket where a fumble allows the batters to take a brace.
Goes 'round the wicket and lands this short and outside off, Beth Mooney cuts it from her back foot but straight to point.
Back of a length and on off, Tahlia McGrath stays back and pushes it to covers for one. That brings up the 50 partnership between these two.
A full toss on middle, Tahlia McGrath looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge towards mid off.
On a length and on off, Tahlia McGrath moves across and works this towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
BEATEN! This is a bit short around off, Tahlia McGrath tries to go for the square cut but misses it completely.
Starts with a floated delivery, full and on off, Tahlia McGrath blocks it to the leg side.
Goes short again and outside off, this is guided to point, Beth Mooney will be dissapointed not to put that away.
Good fielding in the deep. This is flighted and on off, Beth Mooney chips it towards wide long off, the fielder there chases it and dives to stop it from going to the boundary. Two runs taken.
A bit short on off, Beth Mooney pushes this to covers.
FOUR! Good use of the feet there. This floated on middle, Beth Mooney skips down the ground and lofts it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Slower through the air and on off, turning away, Beth Mooney knocks it to point.

Omaima Sohail flights this full on middle and leg, Beth Mooney shuffles down the wicket and gets an inside edge towards square leg, There is hesitation in the running between the wickets as the keeper collects the ball and throws at the non-striker's end. A direct hit and Beth Mooney was gone instead they get another run as the ball goes towards long off.
Tuba Hassan continues bowling full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath reaches for it and punches the ball to the cover fielder.
Full once again and flighted outside off, Tahlia McGrath knocks the ball towards mid off.

FOUR! This has been played fine! Tuba Hassan goes full once again and outside off, Tahlia McGrath shuffles across the stumps and sweeps this to the right of the short fine leg fielder. Runs away to the fine leg fence for the second boundary of the over!
Tuba Hassan goes full and in line with the stumps, Tahlia McGrath fends this back to the bowler.
FOUR! THUMPED! This is tossed up around middle, Tahlia McGrath steps across and smashes it through square leg for a boundary.
Tuba Hassan begins with a fuller ball, and tosses it up, around middle and off. Beth Mooney pushes it towards long off for a single. 50 up for Australia Women!
Tuba Hassan is into the attack.
Good running between the wickets. This is slower through the air and on leg, Tahlia McGrath makes room to work it to the off side but gets an inside edge towards fine leg. Two runs taken.
Tossed up full and on middle, Tahlia McGrath nudges it through mid-wicket. A misfield there and the batters comes back for the second.
BEATEN! This is short and on off, Tahlia McGrath tries to play the cut but gets beaten completely by the extra bounce.
Floated on middle, Beth Mooney eases this to long off for a single.
Four! Nice shot! Tossed up full and around off, Beth Mooney gets to the pitch of it and carves it toward wide long off for a boundary.
WIDE! She bowls this full and down the leg side, Beth Mooney tries to flick but misses. Wided.
Starts with short delivery and on off, Beth Mooney guides it to point.
Omaima Sohail has been given the ball now.
Slightly short, around middle. Beth Mooney pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single. She retains the strike! Another productive over for Australia Women! They are slowly starting to take control!
Loopy delivery, full and around off. Tahlia McGrath strokes it down to long off for another single.
Pitches it up, around middle. Beth Mooney shimmies down the pitch and knocks it towards long on for a single.
Slower through the air, very full, around off. Beth Mooney digs it out towards cover.
Fuller one again, around middle and off. Tahlia McGrath taps it towards cover and rotates the strike!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Australia Women! Tosses this one up, full, and around off. Tahlia McGrath uses her feet and drives it creams her drive through cover for a boundary.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over! A low full toss, around off. Beth Mooney steps down the wicket and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Oh, good bowling! A length ball, outside off. Beth Mooney stays in her crease and tries to push this away but gets undone by the extra bounce there!
Good shot! Fuller ball, outside off. Tahlia McGrath this time connects her drive firmly towards deep cover. But there is protection there! Only a single.
Swing and a miss! On a length now, outside off. Tahlia McGrath lunges forward and goes for the big drive but she fails to get any connection on that.
FOUR! Nicely done! Angling in, on the pads, full again. Tahlia McGrath flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Full in length, this one is shaping away, outside off. Tahlia McGrath drives but finds the fielder at cover-point.

Tosses it up again, around middle. Tahlia McGrath advances down the pitch and strokes it towards long on. Only a single. Excellent Powerplay for Pakistan Women! Australia Women are 22 for 2 at the end of it.
Loopy ball, slower, full, around off. Tahlia McGrath presses forward and blocks it out.
Fuller, tosses it up, around middle. Beth Mooney knocks it down to long on for a single.
Pitches it up, around middle. Tahlia McGrath eases it straight down the ground. Single taken! She gets off the mark!
Tahlia McGrath walks out to the crease.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Terrific delivery from Sadia Iqbal! She gets rid of the dangerous, Meg Lanning! A huge, huge wicket for Pakistan Women! Slower through the air, full, this one lands around middle and spins away. Meg Lanning hangs back and tries to block this one, but she gets beaten. The ball zips past her outside edge and knocks the stumps. Australia Women are 2 down!
Begins with a shorter ball, around middle. Beth Mooney uses the depth of her crease and pulls it towards long on for a single.
Sadia Iqbal has been brought into the attack.
On a length, outside off. Meg Lanning blocks it out. Good over from Diana Baig!
Excellent stop! A fuller ball, around middle. Meg Lanning drives it towards the right of the bowler. Diana Baig dives to her right and makes a terrific stop.
Tight single! Outside off, a length ball. Beth Mooney taps it towards point and runs across to the other end. A good pick-up and a throw from the fielder but Meg Lanning was well in.

Leg bye! Diana Baig goes over the wicket, serves a length ball, angling down leg. Meg Lanning looks to flick this but she misses. The ball deflects off her pads and goes towards square leg. A leg bye taken! An appeal there for LBW, but the umpire says no. Bismah Maroof opts for a review. Ball Tracking indicates that was sliding down leg, and the impact was outside as well. A review wasted!
Another fuller ball, tailing back in, outside off. Beth Mooney pushes it wide of mid off and scampers across to the other end.
An overpitched delivery, outside off. Beth Mooney leans and drives this one to the fielder at cover.
This is on a length and outside off, Meg Lanning mistimes her shot towards mid off.

Four! The full toss and been dispatched to get Meg Lanning off the mark! Fatima Sana serves this fir the batter on a platter and Meg Lanning oblidges as she lofts this over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary! The balls runs away into the vacant deep mid-wicket region to get Meg Lanning her first four!
Fatima Sana goes a fraction full and in line with the stumps, Meg Lanning clips this towards mid-wicket.
Good bowling by the Fatima Sana! She continues bowling on a good length and outside off. Meg Lanning is beaten on the outside edge once again.
Beaten! Fatima Sana serves this on a good length and outside off, Meg Lanning feels for it and the ball swishes past the bat.
Fatima Sana starts of with a full delivery outside off, Beth Mooney punches this towards mid off.
Diana Baig delivers this full and pitching on middle and leg, Meg Lanning fends this towards mid on.
Pulls a length back a fraction, and serves this outside off, Beth Mooney guides the ball to third man for a single.
Diana Baig goes full and wide outside off, Beth Mooney reaches for it and knocks this towards cover. Had she left it alone it would have been called wide.
Pulls her length back a bit and around off, slower too, Beth Mooney stays on her crease and pushes it towards point.
Another full ball on middle, angling into the left hander, Beth Mooney knocks it to mid-wicket.
Diana Baig comes 'round the wicket and serves it full, on middle, angling in too, Beth Mooney keeps it out.
This is on a good length and outside off again, Meg Lanning stays back and punches it hard but straight to point.
Goes full and outside off, Meg Lanning opens the face of her bat and guides it to the cover-point region.
Meg Lanning the skipper of Australia Women walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Fatima Sana strikes and Alyssa Healy can not make the most of the life she was given in the previous over! Fatima Sana goes full and outside off, Alyssa Healy goes to play this through the offside and gets a thick inside edge onto the stumps. Pakistan Women celebrate as they draw first blood! Alyssa Healy departs for a timid score.
Fatima Sana serves this on a good length and close to the stumps, Alyssa Healy knocks this towards mid on.
Full once again and continues bowling outside off, Beth Mooney taps this towards covers and takes a quick single.

FOUR! Beth Mooney gets off the mark in style! Fatima Sana goes full and outside off, Beth Mooney caresses the ball through the gap and gets a boundary to deep cover! Australia Women getting a move on here!
Fatima Sana will bowl from the other end.

Dropped! Pakistan Women have let go of a golden opportunity to strike early! Diana Baig serves this full and outside off, Alyssa Healy goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge that flies to first slip. The fielder goes to snatch at it and drops it! A chance gone begging!
This is on a good length and outside off, Alyssa Healy pushes at it gets beaten on the outside edge.

FOUR! This one has been dispatched! Diana Baig goes full once again outside off, Alyssa Healy hits this hard through the cover-point region in the air and finds the gap. Runs away to deep cover-point fence for Australia Women's first boundary!
Diana Baig goes full once again and just outside off, Alyssa Healy knocks this towards cover.
On a good length and outside off, Alyssa Healy works this towards point.
Good start for Diana Baig! She serves this full and in line with the stumps, shade of outswing on it. Alyssa Healy fends this back to the bowler.

We are ready for action to get underway! The umpires have made their way out to the middle. The players stride out as well. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney open the batting for Australia Women. Diana Baig will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Muneeba Ali (WK), Bismah Maroof (C), Iram Javed, Omaima Sohail, Ayesha Naseem, Aliya Riaz, Fatima Sana, Tuba Hassan, Diana Baig, Aiman Anwer (In for Anam Amin), Sadia Iqbal (In for Kainat Imtiaz).

Australia Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Tahlia McGrath, Rachael Haynes, Ashleigh Gardner, Grace Harris, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.
TOSS - Australia Women have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!
